notes: The manual excerpt only says the PIR's three pins connect to the Raspberry Pi; it gives no pin numbers or image of the wiring.
Assumed the standard Raspberry Pi PIR wiring: VCC to 5V, GND to GND, OUT to GPIO14.
No breadboard is mentioned, so the sensor is wired straight to the Pi header with jumper wires. The catalogue has no female-female wire type, so the generic jumper-wire is used.
Wire colours are assumed (red, yellow, black).
